mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 4.5% indicates tightening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 450000.
